Artifacts.Name: Module Topics
Artifacts.Description: Covers the core topics of the module—comparing locally hosted and cloud-based database deployment models, including infrastructure setup, management responsibilities, and specific managed services such as AWS RDS and Azure—serving as a navigational overview that helps instructors sequence lessons and learners understand what concepts they will study.

Artifacts.Name: Module Topics (HTML)
Artifacts.Description: Outlines the module's topics on cloud and local database deployment models—covering definitions, infrastructure comparisons, and foundational concepts—to help learners and instructors navigate what will be taught throughout the module.

Artifacts.Name: Introduction to Database Deployment Models
Artifacts.Description: This reading introduces the concept of database deployment models, explaining what they are and why choosing where a database lives—and who manages it—is a foundational organizational decision; learners use it as a conceptual entry point before exploring specific deployment options.

Artifacts.Name: Locally Hosted Database Systems
Artifacts.Description: This reading covers on-premises database deployments, explaining how locally hosted systems work, what hardware and software responsibilities fall to the organization, and the trade-offs involved; learners use it to understand the full scope of managing a database entirely within their own facilities.

Artifacts.Name: Cloud-Based Database Services
Artifacts.Description: This reading explains managed cloud database services, describing how major cloud providers host and operate database infrastructure on behalf of organizations; learners use it to understand the shift away from physical servers and the capabilities that cloud-based database offerings provide.

Artifacts.Name: Cost Comparison: Cloud vs. Local
Artifacts.Description: This reading examines the financial trade-offs between cloud-hosted and on-premises database deployments, covering total cost of ownership beyond surface-level pricing; learners and instructors use it to guide rigorous cost-benefit analysis when evaluating deployment decisions.

Artifacts.Name: Scalability and Performance
Artifacts.Description: This reading compares how cloud and on-premises database deployments handle scalability and performance as data volumes and user demand grow, explaining the mechanisms each model uses to expand capacity and maintain response times; learners use it to evaluate deployment options against operational performance requirements.

Artifacts.Name: Maintenance and Administration
Artifacts.Description: This reading covers the operational responsibilities of database maintenance and administration under cloud versus on-premises models, addressing patching, backups, monitoring, and optimization along with their staffing and budget implications; learners use it to understand how deployment choice shapes day-to-day administrative workload.

Artifacts.Name: Availability, Reliability, and Security
Artifacts.Description: This reading examines availability, reliability, and security considerations when choosing between cloud and on-premises database hosting, explaining how each model addresses uptime, data loss prevention, and data protection; learners use it to evaluate deployment options against business continuity and compliance requirements.
